notes: Eggs, lucky blocks that pay out, and money spent on more pets is a Simulation progression loop, so the preset is Incremental Simulator for that mode. Its world-open shape is replaced by tier-ladder, because the goal answer describes exactly what that row is: twelve small areas in a readable run, each walled off from the next until a number crosses a threshold, rising from one pet for area two to eleven for area twelve. Keeping the preset's shared world would have thrown away the one thing that gives this map its structure, and tier-ladder costs nothing extra, so the build stays on P0. With no user to ask I did not import Stat Grinder's training station or rebirth pad, since neither appears here, and I read the lucky blocks and eggs as the collectible nodes scattered through each yard-sized zone; the twelve areas and their rising unlock counts are recorded here as the config has nowhere to carry a number.
